keyEvents.text: Conor McGrandles (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Paul Smyth (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Queens Park Rangers 1, Lincoln City 0. Richard Kone (Queens Park Rangers) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Boy Kemper with a headed pass.
Goal! Queens Park Rangers 1, Lincoln City 1. Dom Jefferies (Lincoln City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Freddie Draper following a fast break.
Yunus Konak (Lincoln City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Queens Park Rangers 1, Lincoln City 1.
Second Half begins Queens Park Rangers 1, Lincoln City 1.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Rob Street replaces Mikkel Ladefoged.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Ilias Chair replaces Harvey Vale.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Karamoko Dembélé replaces Kwame Poku.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Dennis Cirkin replaces Boy Kemper.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Bayliss replaces Yunus Konak.
Substitution, Lincoln City. Tom Hamer replaces Reeco Hackett.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Koki Saito replaces Paul Smyth.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Justin Obikwu replaces Richard Kone.
Goal! Queens Park Rangers 2, Lincoln City 1. Glen Kamara (Queens Park Rangers) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Ilias Chair.
